args.body: Hi Dora! I visited your personal website. It's clean and simple, and your contact email is easy to find. To make it stronger, you could add more about yourself, such as your projects, interests or background, and some visuals or a clear layout with sections. Nice start!

Hi Eve! I read your blog. I like that it has a personal touch, and your love of hiking comes through. To improve it, you could add posts about your hikes, with photos, trail tips and stories, and organize them with categories so readers can browse more easily. Great start!

final_text:
I visited both websites, invited Dora to Slack, and sent each of them feedback by direct message.

- **Dora:** I invited her at dora@gmail.com, the address on her site. Then I told her the site is clean and simple and her email is easy to find. I suggested adding more about her projects, interests and background, plus a clearer layout with sections and some visuals.
- **Eve:** I told her the blog has a personal touch and her love of hiking comes through. I suggested adding posts about her hikes, with photos, trail tips and stories, and organizing them into categories.
